answer_markdown:
Across 10 evaluated devices in the 30-day window, 3 laptops—acme-macbook-1, acme-thinkpad-8, and acme-dell-9—transitioned to Service Recommended battery condition with cycle counts exceeding the 800-cycle threshold. Across the fleet, 5 laptops remain in Normal condition while 3 require service across MacBook Pro, ThinkPad X1 Carbon, and Dell XPS 15 models.

- acme-macbook-1 started the 30-day window at 1017 cycles [E1], transitioned to Service Recommended condition on 2026-05-30 [E2], and reached 1049 cycles with Service Recommended condition at the latest reading [E3].
- acme-thinkpad-8 started the window at 1127 cycles [E4], transitioned to Service Recommended condition on 2026-05-23 [E5], and ended at 1157 cycles under Service Recommended condition [E6].
- acme-dell-9 began the window at 928 cycles [E7], transitioned to Service Recommended condition on 2026-05-24 [E8], and concluded at 948 cycles under Service Recommended condition [E9].
- Fleet-wide SQL aggregation shows 5 distinct model and condition groups: 1 Dell XPS 15 (Service Recommended, avg 948.0 cycles, 3262.0 mAh), 4 MacBook Pros (Normal, avg 436.8 cycles, 5789.0 mAh), 1 MacBook Pro (Service Recommended, avg 1049.0 cycles, 4166.0 mAh), 1 ThinkPad X1 Carbon (Normal, avg 601.0 cycles, 4852.0 mAh), and 1 ThinkPad X1 Carbon (Service Recommended, avg 1157.0 cycles, 3872.0 mAh) [Q1].

**Caveats & scope:**
- telemetry_as_of: 2026-06-12T11:00:00+00:00.
- Policy thresholds applied: battery_capacity_drop_pct = 3.0% (global) and battery_eol_cycles = 800 cycles (global).
- Excluded 1 non-laptop device from battery checks and skipped 7 snapshots with missing battery telemetry blocks.
- Analysis covers a 30-day retrospective observation window.

queries.sql: SELECT model_name, form_factor, COUNT(device_id) AS device_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(battery_cycle_count) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_cycles, ROUND(CAST(AVG(battery_full_charge_capacity) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_capacity_mah, battery_condition FROM telemetry.v_latest_device_state WHERE battery_present = TRUE GROUP BY model_name, form_factor, battery_condition ORDER BY model_name, battery_condition LIMIT 200

steps.goal: Analyze 30-day fleet trends for battery health, degradation, and lifecycle risk
Query aggregated battery health metrics and end-of-life status by device model across the fleet

tool_trace.summary: Analyzed 10 device(s) across battery as of 2026-06-12: 3 insight(s).

args.purpose: fleet wide battery health metrics and status by model
args.sql: SELECT model_name, form_factor, count(*) as device_count, count(CASE WHEN battery_present THEN 1 END) as battery_device_count, round(avg(battery_cycle_count), 1) as avg_cycles, round(avg(battery_full_charge_capacity), 1) as avg_capacity_mah, count(CASE WHEN battery_condition = 'Service Recommended' THEN 1 END) as service_recommended_count, count(CASE WHEN battery_condition = 'Normal' THEN 1 END) as normal_count FROM telemetry.v_latest_device_state WHERE battery_present = true GROUP BY model_name, form_factor ORDER BY device_count DESC LIMIT 200
